name: Trial by Poison Trap
disable: DC 23 Thievery check (trained) to disable the launcher or DC 26 Arcana check (expert) or DC 26 Occultism check (expert) to disable the nearby magical sensor
reset: The trap resets when an operator at the maze console in area A13 pulls the associated lever. The trap can be reset only once per minute.

items.name: Toxic Barrage
items.text:
Trigger An operator at the maze console in area A13 pulls the associated lever

---
Effect A dart launcher emerges from the ceiling and makes a poison dart Strike against two different creatures in the area marked on the map. A single creature can't be targeted more than once.

text: A dart launcher embedded in the ceiling holds a cartridge of darts tipped with deadly poison.
